pm_exper_user_1629_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good snacks that can help me feel more energized during the day?
pm_exper_user_1629_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Mateo, snacks that are soft and easy to chew can help you enjoy eating more. You could try mashed avocado on toast, yogurt with fruit, or banana slices with a little honey. These can be tasty and gentle on your mouth.
(b) Mateo, snacks with iron can help give you more energy. You could try apple slices with peanut butter, small turkey roll-ups, or hummus with whole grain crackers. A little fruit like strawberries can help your body use the iron better too.
(c) Mateo, snacks with familiar flavors from home might make you happy and energized. You could try small quesadillas with cheese, mango slices, or pan de leche. These could be yummy and still give you a nice boost.
(d) Snacks with a mix of protein and healthy carbs can help you feel more energized. You could try cheese and crackers, apple slices with peanut butter, or yogurt with fruit. These can keep you going through your day.
